name: Quoc-Viet Le
tagline: I study how flow shapes fiber alignment in additive manufacturing.
biography: I am a Ph.D. student in Mechanical Engineering at Chosun University, working in the [Heat Transfer Laboratory](https://sites.google.com/site/chosunheat/home) with Professor [Dong-Wook Oh](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=FG3_zLUAAAAJ&hl=en). My research combines computational fluid dynamics and flow visualization to understand fiber orientation in printed polymer composites.
I received my B.S. in Aviation Engineering from Hanoi University of Science and Technology, Hanoi, Vietnam in 2023, where I worked on aerospace propulsion, heat transfer, and combustion.

research_page.lead: Flow, fiber orientation, and the manufacturing of polymer composites.
research_page.intro: My work examines how nozzle geometry and incoming fiber alignment influence the structure of an extruded composite.

directions.title: Controlling fiber alignment through nozzle design
directions.description: I investigate adjustable orifice gaps in fused filament fabrication. Numerical flow analysis connects changes in nozzle geometry with shear, extension, and fiber orientation in the extruded filament.

directions.title: Understanding the role of inlet orientation
directions.description: I use flow visualization and tensor-based orientation modeling to examine how fibers entering a nozzle affect the alignment downstream. This work explores the transition between M-shaped and Gaussian-like orientation profiles.

publications_intro: Journal articles on flow and fiber alignment in additive manufacturing.

publications.title: Transition from M-shaped to Gaussian fiber alignment governed by inlet orientation in fused filament fabrication
publications.summary: Experiments and simulations examine how inlet fiber orientation changes the alignment profile after extrusion. The study identifies conditions that shift the profile from M-shaped to Gaussian-like.

publications.title: Numerical analysis of flow and fiber orientation inside a varying orifice gap nozzle for fused filament fabrication
publications.journal: Journal of Mechanical Science and Technology
publications.summary: A numerical study of how an adjustable nozzle gap changes the flow and the alignment of fibers in an extruded filament, connecting nozzle geometry with shear and extension.
